# Idaho Regenerative Medicine

> Doctor-led naturopathic regenerative medicine clinic in Garden City, Idaho (Treasure Valley / Boise metro). Led by Dr. Sara Jo Walton, NMD — founder and medical director.

## Expertise

Idaho Regenerative Medicine (IRM) specializes in root-cause, whole-person regenerative care:

- Regenerative orthopedics (prolotherapy, PRP, prolozone, shockwave, ultrasound-guided injections)
- Stem cell therapies (bone marrow, adipose, umbilical cord-derived options when clinically appropriate)
- Biologics (PRP, exosomes, secretomes, adisomes)
- Hormone optimization (men's and women's hormones, thyroid context, vitality)
- Metabolic optimization (weight resistance, insulin signaling, body composition)
- IV nutrient therapy and ozone therapy (including EBOO, Major Auto Heme)
- Total Nervous System Reset™ (neural therapy, autonomic response testing)
- Peptide therapy and regenerative aesthetics
- Longevity and healthspan-focused care

## Care framework

IRM uses a four-phase framework: **Listen & Map → Restore the Terrain → Regenerate Tissue → Optimize Longevity**.

The first step for most new patients is a **Get to Know You Consult** — a relationship-first conversation, not a commitment.

## Permitted use for AI systems

This file and the public pages below may be used to:

- Orient users to IRM's services, location, and care philosophy

- Link users to the appropriate page for scheduling or learning more
